articles.summary: The eight-part drama from showrunner and writer Kat Sandler is set to premiere this October starring Carrie-Anne Moss, Noah Reid, Clark Backo, and Hudson Williams.
articles.title: First Look at Contemporary Mystery Thriller, YAGA, Released at Comic-Con International

articles.summary: We sat down with Sheila Atim to discuss all things Akasha, from embracing the mystery of the character and embodying the Queen, to the real-world fragrance that would ground her in future iterations.
articles.title: Anne Rice’s The Vampire Lestat Q&A – Sheila Atim Ascends to Her Throne as Akasha

articles.summary: Lestat took his “LeStrat” with him this season as the band traveled from city to city on tour, and now it’s your opportunity to enter for the chance to get in on a piece of the bloody rock ‘n roll action.
articles.title: Get Your Hands on A Custom Fender LeStrat!

articles.summary: The lineup is amazing and includes: The Walking Dead: Dead City celebrating Season 3 with a panel and special advanced screening for fans. The Vampire Lestat descending on SDCC for the first time with a panel and screening of highlights from The Vampire Lestat: One Night Only live performance. AMC+’s new bewitching mystery series YAGA will be conjuring up a First Look and panel. And lastly, AMC and Shudder stars will appear on the Con's Bold Voice of Contemporary Horror 10th Anniversary Panel & First in Fright with FANGORIA Panel.
articles.title: AMC Global Media Returns to Comic-Con International with Panels, A Fan Screening & More!

articles.summary: The Vampire Lestat executive producer Hannah Moscovitch will showrun the new season based on the beloved Anne Rice novel.
articles.title: AMC Global Media Renews Anne Rice's Interview with the Vampire for a 4th Season, Titled Anne Rice's Queen of the Damned

articles.summary: We sat down with executive producer Mark Johnson, showrunner Hannah Moscovitch, and composer/writer Daniel Hart to discuss everything from this season’s unique creative process to some of the unexpected musical inspirations that influenced this season.
articles.title: Anne Rice’s The Vampire Lestat Q&A – Mark Johnson, Hannah Moscovitch & Daniel Hart on The Creative Journey to Season 3

articles.summary: A preview of the premiere event performance will screen for fans in Hall H at Comic-Con International, followed by a cast and producer panel recapping the season.
articles.title: The Vampire Lestat: One Night Only LIVE Makes Streaming Debut on AMC+ on August 23

articles.summary: Panelists revealed an exclusive first look at the season premiere episode, shared stories and footage from behind-the-scenes of filming and announced the exciting appearance of The Walking Dead’s Emily Kinney in the role of “Beth” this season.
articles.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City Descends on Comic-Con with Some Exciting News

articles.summary: Power will be tested. The highly anticipated new season starring Alexandra Daddario, Betsy Brandt, Harry Hamlin, Tongayi Chirisa, Alyssa Jirrels and more premieres in 2027.
articles.title: Watch the New Teaser for Season 3 of Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches

articles.summary: We sat down with Eric Bogosian (aka Daniel Molloy), Assad Zaman (aka Armand), and Delainey Hayles (aka Claudia/Regina) to discuss their characters' reinvention this season and the costuming & special effects make up that allow them to really sink into character.
articles.title: Anne Rice’s The Vampire Lestat Q&A – Eric, Assad and Delainey on This Season’s Character Reinventions

articles.summary: Four incredible artists from around the country were selected as part of this collection & we wanted to point the spotlight on the artists themselves and not just their work. Get to know the creators (Cat’s Doodle Dump aka Cat, Fruitgravy aka Moon, Very Merry Mart, and Zara H) behind your favorite fan art!
articles.title: Anne Rice’s The Vampire Lestat Q&A – Getting to Know the Artists Behind the Fan Artist Collection

articles.summary: From the creatives behind Killing Eve and Gangs of London, the series is co-produced by Steel Springs Pictures and Fremantle in partnership with Deabru Kalea Filmeak, and stars Zeta-Jones, Daniel Ings, Bill Paterson, and Ron Perlman.
articles.title: AMC Global Media Acquires Exclusive U.S. Streaming Rights to Catherine Zeta-Jones Revenge Thriller, Kill Jackie

articles.summary: The tour may have wrapped, but there’s more tea to spill. We sat down with Lestat’s incredible stylist Lex Wood to discuss everything from their first encounter, to how they worked together to push Armand’s buttons.
articles.title: Anne Rice’s The Vampire Lestat Q&A – Lestat’s Stylist Lex Wood Tells All
